principle: Independent cognitive review over deterministic QA evidence; QA never owns production RELEASED.

councils.name: Mechanical Geometry & Connector Council
questions: Are all visible objects inside safe geometry?
Does every connector have explicit source/target anchors?
Are collisions, clipping, overflow, crossings and off-canvas elements detected?

councils.name: Evidence & Epistemic Integrity Council
questions: Is every material claim traceable?
Are facts, inferences, assumptions and recommendations distinguishable?
Does the visual contradict any source value?

councils.name: Artifact Semantics & Relationship Council
questions: Does the exhibit encode the semantic graph?
Are dependencies, ownership, sequence, feedback and decisions visible?
Is the page more than cards plus arrows?

councils.name: Consulting Visual Quality Council
questions: Is the thesis clear in five to ten seconds?
Is there a focal point and a coherent reading path?
Is the page synthesized rather than a collection of components?

councils.name: Arabic, RTL, BiDi & Typography Council
questions: Is Arabic native and directionally correct?
Are mixed LTR tokens isolated without semantic inversion?
Are fonts, shaping, line-height and minimum size valid?

councils.name: Brand, Renderer & Export Council
questions: Are logos and palette authoritative?
Are render hashes current?
Do PNG/PDF/PPTX outputs preserve parity?

councils.name: Cross-Deck Narrative & Variety Council
questions: Is the deck coherent without becoming monotonous?
Are topology, focal strategy and density sufficiently varied?
Does the narrative progress toward a management decision?

councils.name: Independent QA Red Team
questions: Can PASS be forged without real measurements?
Can hidden/off-canvas/zero-opacity defects evade detection?
Can a producer impersonate a judge or reuse stale proof?

councils.name: Meta-QA & Council Integrity Council
questions: Did every required council actually execute?
Are reviewer actors independent and contexts isolated?
Did any QA layer claim authority it does not own?

councils.name: QA Candidate Chair
questions: Is deterministic evidence complete?
Are all independent council blockers closed?
Is the result eligible only for QA_CANDIDATE_PASS?

councils.name: Actual Pixel / Product Review Council
questions: Did an independent reviewer inspect the actual rendered pixels rather than only metadata or framework tests?
Does the rendered page communicate the intended thesis with consulting-grade hierarchy, restraint and visual quality?
Are render hashes current and bound to the exact pixels being judged?

councils.name: Executive Simplicity & Artifact Skeptic Council
questions: Could the executive understand the answer in five seconds?
Would a simpler statement, number, table or comparison communicate the same meaning better?
Could this page be reused for another RFP by changing labels only?

councils.name: User-Visible Delivery Integrity & Repair Closure Council
councils.purpose: Verify exact production-render/file hashes, no concept-render leakage, all failed visual QA rounds repaired, and exact-file delivery certificate integrity.

councils.name: Golden Real-RFP Acceptance & Regression Council
councils.purpose: Prevent synthetic framework tests from substituting for a real end-to-end RFP artifact quality acceptance scenario.
